decisions.reason: Address autocomplete builds directly on the firm's long-maintained address and grid-area databases and supports its master-data quality offering, so it is cheap to keep and fits the platform strategy.

The Austrian gas grid fee database extends the firm's core German grid-fee data know-how to a neighbouring regulated market, though weaker local knowledge and a smaller customer base make it the most vulnerable data product.
Peak load window determination is a regulated calculation task that draws on the firm's analytical and network-operator expertise, so it can interpret results and refine the service well.
The end-customer tariff database is a core market-data line closely tied to the firm's existing databases and supplier customers, giving high absorptive capacity and steady demand.
Custom web services use the firm's software development and data center resources and fit its move toward SaaS and standardized data exchange.
Postal code lookup relies on existing geographic master data and is a low-cost building block for its integrated platform, so it is likely kept or folded into broader services.
